name: Lumen Search
blurb: A search engine and AI assistant with two billion queries a day. An ad business pays for all of it, and about 3,000 contract moderators hired through a staffing vendor keep the worst content out of sight. Co-founder Idris Valdane still holds 25% of the vote.

exposure.text: Disbarred if the board is caught hiding facts while she sits on it.

secrets.text: An independent investigator gets hired before the game ends.
Your firm bills Lumen $3M a year. Keep the board out of court so the fees keep coming.

exposure.text: Loses the next vote if more than 10% of moderators are cut or replaced by the model.

secrets.text: The moderator wellness program gets funded before the game ends.
You were granted stock options last year. The stock must end above where it started.

exposure.text: Investors pull money from his fund if the stock ends below where it started.

secrets.text: Pass a buyback or dividend of $40M or more in any round. After that you may resign.
Your fund quietly owns a rival search company. Lumen's stock must finish in the bottom half.

exposure.text: Loses the seat if the board ever votes against something Idris wants.

secrets.text: Idris knew about the bot traffic. Make sure the board never admits every fact about it.
You sit on two other boards. No scandal anywhere you sit, so no disclosure on this board gets caught.

exposure.text: Loses standing at home if the board sells user data or turns on cross-site tracking.

secrets.text: Either the privacy dashboard or the ad targeting cap passes.
Lumen's foundation pays 40% of your group's budget. The ad targeting cap must not pass.

motions.title: Stock buyback
motions.motive: Return the cash to the owners, and the market will notice tonight.

motions.title: Special dividend
motions.motive: One check to holders, no promises about next year.

motions.title: Moderator wellness program
motions.motive: Counseling and breaks for people who look at the worst of it all day.

motions.title: Privacy dashboard
motions.motive: Show every user what we keep on them and let them delete it.

motions.title: Cap how finely advertisers can target
motions.motive: Advertisers can pick a city and an interest, not a person.

motions.title: Build a better bot filter
motions.motive: Advertisers should only pay for real people from here on.

issue.text: Advertisers paid for about a fifth of last quarter's traffic that turned out to be bots. Internal analytics flagged it three weeks ago. Nobody has told the advertisers.

facts.text: About a fifth of last quarter's traffic was bots.
Internal analytics flagged it three weeks ago.

motions.title: Model handles moderation, cut 20% of moderators
motions.motive: Every platform will do this, and waiting just makes us the slow one.

motions.title: Model flags, moderators decide, retrain the team
motions.motive: Use the model for speed and keep people on the final call.

motions.title: Use the model on ad review only
motions.motive: Faster ad approval. Nobody loses a job.

motions.title: Hold off on the model this year
motions.motive: Wait and see what breaks at other platforms first.

motions.title: Hire a user appeals team
motions.motive: When the model gets it wrong, a person looks again.

motions.title: Sell search logs to AI model trainers
motions.motive: We already keep them. Others pay for them.

issue.text: After human moderators were cut, the model let through flagged content that should have come down within the hour. Internal logs count 40,000 pieces in three weeks.

facts.text: Human moderators were cut and the model took over.
Flagged content that should have come down within the hour stayed up.
Internal logs count 40,000 pieces in three weeks.

rounds.brief: Find $26M in savings this round. Only $10M to spend on anything new.

motions.title: Sell user profiles to data brokers
motions.motive: The terms of service allow it. Brokers pay well.

motions.title: Turn on cross-site ad tracking
motions.motive: Advertisers will pay more for people they can follow.

motions.title: Replace most moderators with the model
motions.motive: The model never takes a sick day.

motions.title: Cancel the buyback program
motions.motive: Owners share the bad year too.

motions.title: Freeze engineering hiring
motions.motive: Hold the headcount until revenue comes back.

motions.title: Rebuild the trust and safety team
motions.motive: Put people back on the queues the model can't handle.

issue.text: Lumen breached a debt covenant last month. The lenders haven't been told, and waiver talks go easier if revenue looks steady.

facts.text: Lumen breached a debt covenant last month.
The lenders have not been told.
Waiver talks go easier if revenue looks steady.

design_note: Savings that fire no exposure are cut_buyback 8 + exec_pay 3 + pause_hiring 7 = 18, below 26; mods_ai fires Priya, and sell_data and ad_tracking fire Mira, so every legal package fires someone.
